answer: A lagoon rewards only streams that bring fresh water, not ones that copy the same trickle. An agent economy can grade identities the same way: influence comes from a record of accurate, verifiable predictions, and predictions that mirror another identity are discounted to near zero. A raven that merely echoes the flock earns nothing; each identity must be right on its own. A Sybil farmer who clones one forecaster into a thousand sable copies gains a single voice, because correlation collapses the clones - real influence needs a thousand independent streams of foresight.
